headline: This 2015 Ferrari 458 Speciale is Now Available at duPont REGISTRY Select!
overview: Finished in Nero DS with a Blu Nart Racing Stripe over a Nero interior and showing just 6,042 miles, this exceptional 458 Speciale is a stunning example of one of Ferrari's most celebrated modern collector cars. Widely regarded as the ultimate evolution of Ferrari's naturally aspirated mid-engine V8 platform, the Speciale is powered by a 4.5-liter naturally aspirated V8 producing 597 horsepower and revving to 9,000 rpm. Extensive weight reduction, active aerodynamics, side slip control, and extensive use of carbon fiber distinguish the Speciale from the standard 458 Italia and deliver an even more focused driving experience. This example is further protected by Full-Body PPF.
